_note: Monthly cover plan, kept in git. One entry per publication per month. File: public/covers/<slug>/<YYYY-MM>.webp (portrait, under 400 KB). A cover is used only when approved:true AND today >= release (normally the 1st of the month); it then stays current until the next month's approved cover is released. made_by records who produced it (gpt, joe, ...). masthead must read the publication's name (or an approved alias). Run: npm run check:covers. See docs/monthly-covers.md.
